title: Polar Bottle Breakaway Wave Lightweight Bike Water Bottle - BPA-Free, Cycling & Sports Squeeze Bottle
features: LIGHTWEIGHT BIKE WATER BOTTLE: The original, 100% BPA-free water bottle - our water bottle features a sleek, single-wall design that is light, durable, compact, and fits most bike cages
HIGH-FLOW, SELF-SEALING CAP: The Breakaway Surge Cap maximizes flow rate and self-seals to eliminate spills and splatter: It’s spill-proof when open and pushes closed for leakproof transport
EASY TO CLEAN: The innovative cap is two pieces - cap and valve - simply twist and pull for complete access cleaning; all our squeeze water bottles and caps are dishwasher safe
VERSATILE: Your go-to sports water bottle for cycling, team sports, the gym, the studio, or on the trail; optimally designed for easier squeeze and grip for use on the go
MADE IN THE USA: We are proud to produce all Polar Bottle products in Colorado and source all our parts in the USA
description: The Breakaway reusable water bottle was crafted in Colorado for cyclists by cyclists. The newly re-engineered single-wall design is light, durable, and compact to cut down on bulk on your bike. Trusted by cycling adventurers for over 25 years, the Breakaway bike water bottle offers superior performance. Optimized to fit in a variety of bike cages and effortless to grab and squeeze. The high-flow Surge Cap provides a sip or blast of water and self-seals to eliminate spills and splatter, even on your bumpiest rides. Allowing you to take in more water with less effort. Just like the original, every Polar Bottle is 100% BPA-free, dishwasher safe, made in Colorado USA, and comes with a Lifetime Warranty.
